newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mokhzani makes general offer for Pantai.
newsitem.headline: Mokhzani makes general offer for Pantai.

text.p: Malaysian businessman Mokhzani Mahathir on Saturday made a takeover general offer for the remaining shares in Hospital Pantai Bhd not already owned by him and his Tongkah Holdings Bhd.

A statement issued by Mokhzani's merchant banker said the cash offer was extended to holders of the medical group's Irredeemable Convertible Unsecured Loan Stocks (ICULS) and Employees' Share Option Scheme (ESOS) option holders.

Mokhzani, a son of Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad, recently announced his acquisition of 35.53 percent equity interest in Pantai for 306.3 million ringgit from Berjaya Group, or 13.75 ringgit a share.
Mokhzani is executive chairman and chief executive officer of Tongkah. Diversified Tongkah currently holds a 21 percent stake in Hospital Pantai and 13.1 million ringgit nominal amount of its ICULS.
Mokhzani offered to pay 13.75 ringgit for each issued share in Pantai or for new shares to be issued from the exercise of the ESOS or conversion of ICULS.
He also offered to pay 4.38 ringgit for every ICULS.
Hospital Pantai stock closed at 16.40 ringgit on Friday.
